info.title: dotnet-kestrun
info.description: Kestrun CLI tool for script-hosted service lifecycle operations.

options.name: --version
options.description: Optional specific version for install/update.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Module storage scope: 'local' (default) or 'global'.

options.name: --force
options.description:
Overwrite existing target version folder for update operations.
Notes:
- install: fails when Kestrun is already installed; use 'kestrun module update'.
- update: updates to latest when no --version is provided and fails if the target version folder exists unless --force is supplied.
- remove: removes all installed versions from the selected scope and shows deletion progress in interactive terminals.
- info: shows installed module versions and latest Gallery version for the selected scope.
- Windows global scope for install/update/remove prompts for elevation (UAC) when needed.

options.name: --script
options.description: Optional named script path (alternative to positional <main.ps1>).

options.name: --kestrun-manifest
options.description: Use an explicit Kestrun.psd1 manifest file.

options.name: --arguments
options.description:
Pass remaining values to the script as script arguments.
Notes:
- If no script is provided, ./Service.ps1 is used.
- Script arguments must be passed after --arguments (or --).
- Use --kestrun-manifest to pin a specific Kestrun.psd1 file.
- If Kestrun is missing, run 'kestrun module install'.
